title: Embeddable guest open-a-ticket form
summary: Administrators can publish guest open-a-ticket forms that other APES websites embed in an iframe, with email confirmation before staff are notified.
changes: Admin → Embed forms manages guest ticket forms, allowed parent origins, public keys and the copy-paste loader snippet.
Other websites load /embed/tickets/loader.js; the form page has no workspace chrome and uses signed origin tokens with CSP frame-ancestors limited to the allowlist.
Guests submit name, email, service, area, subject and details with GDPR consent; reCAPTCHA v3 and honeypot reuse the existing bot protection.
Staff are notified only after the guest confirms their email. Matching public accounts own the ticket after verify; staff Cloudron emails cannot become guest owners.
/open-a-ticket stays the login-first public flow from v0.65. Help and the Tickets wiki describe the embed path.
affected_areas: Security headers (CSP frame-ancestors on embed responses)
version_rationale: Minor: new embeddable guest ticket capability without breaking the existing login-first /open-a-ticket path.
validation: TicketEmbedFormTest feature suite on the local Herd PHPUnit run (9 tests).
known_limitations: Text-only submissions; file uploads on the embed form are not in this release.
Guest tickets do not create a Public Account yet; that lands with v0.82.0.
rollback: Redeploy the v0.68.1 tag. Embed tables and nullable guest columns are additive; disable or delete embed forms in Admin if needed before rolling back.
